adversarial.description: The resolved-to-open case asserts the exact reopened bucket, absence from persisting/stale, and byte-for-structure preservation of the later evidence. A separate corpus verifies new, resolved, persisting, stale, and pre-window-resolved classifications. The scratch helper is exercised by all eleven probe subshells, rejects a repository TMPDIR before allocation, and proves its recorded temporary root is absent after the EXIT trap.
